navigation.notes: Platform is Squarespace, NOT wordpress (the registry carried both values; wordpress was wrong). This seed covers Tulane Law Review ONLINE only, ~39 pieces, roughly volumes 91-100. The PRINT journal is not scrapable: /pub/volumeNN/issueM/<slug> holds ~2,300 abstract stubs for volumes 52-100 (1977-2026) whose only full-text link is Westlaw. A 30-page random sample across that range found zero PDFs. See tulane_law_review.json for the print-side status stub.
